title: Izwi Lokuhlakanipha
intro: Izwi lokuhlakanipha elimnene elake labelwana ngalo ngeseluleko esidlula isikhathi. Lesi sibalo, esibusiswe ngokuqonda okujulile, sadlulisela izifundo ezibalulekile ezihlala ziyisibonakaliso kubo bonke abalangazelela isiqondiso. Ungakwazi yini ukuhlukanisa ukuthi ungubani ngemuva kwala mazwi ahlala njalo?
clues: Nganikwa isibusiso esikhulu esivela ku-Allah, isipho esakhanyisa inhliziyo yami nengqondo yami.
Ngaphendukela enganeni yami ethandekayo, ngifisa ukwabelana ngengcebo eyigugu kakhulu enganginayo.
Ngaxwayisa ngokuthi ukungabi nabulungisa okukhulu kakhulu ukwakha abalingani noNkulunkulu oyedwa weqiniso.
Ngakhumbuza ukuthi ngisho nesisindo sembewu yesinaphi, esifihliwe edwaleni noma ngale kwesibhakabhaka, sizolandiswa ngu-Allah.
Ngayala ukuba ngibe nesibopho kubazali, nakuba ukulalela kungokwezindaba zokulunga kuphela.
Ngafundisa imikhuba elula: hamba ngokuthobeka emhlabeni futhi ulinganisele izwi lakho; ngoba umsindo onzima kakhulu ukukhala kwezimbongolo.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
